note: Review of generated edge cases against spec.md, by Claude. 'gap' = the spec does not say what happens.

cases.expected: A second press must not create a second order or charge. Disable the button on press and make the request idempotent.
After a time limit, show the definite order state (looked up on the server) instead of a generic error.
Keep the basket and slot, say the order was not placed, retry when back online.
If payment succeeds but the order fails (or the reverse), reconcile automatically and tell the customer which state they are in.
If a price or stock level changed between review and placement, show the change and ask once before charging.
Specific message, safe retry, basket and slot kept.
Sign in again and return to the same step with the basket intact.
cases.note: Lower than the default: sessions on a phone app rarely expire inside a one-minute flow.

cases.expected: A slot error must not reset stock decisions made in the previous step.

cases.note: Nothing is typed at this step in the base design.

cases.expected: A customer with no past order should not see the entry points, or should see a starter basket.
cases.note: The spec lists this as undecided; in the simulation about nine in ten new customers who start are blocked.

cases.expected: On repeat use, remember the usual slot and substitute choices.

cases.step_name: Confirms payment with the saved card
cases.title: Saved card is expired or will be declined
cases.question: When is the card checked, and what happens to the basket and slot if it fails?
cases.expected: Check the expiry date when the sheet opens; on decline, stay in the flow, hold the slot, offer another payment method.

cases.title: Customer wants only some of the items
cases.question: Can items be unticked or quantities changed?
cases.expected: Allow untick and quantity change in the sheet; otherwise one-off orders make reorder useless.

cases.title: Most or all items are unavailable
cases.question: What does the sheet show when little of the last order can be bought today?
cases.expected: Say so up front and offer the regular shop instead of an empty reorder.

cases.title: Removing items drops the basket below the minimum order value
cases.question: Is the minimum checked after removals, and what is offered?
cases.expected: Show the shortfall and suggest items to add.
